description: 24-prompt seller intelligence hard-eval dataset: 12 commercial categories × 2 cases (medium/hard difficulty). Derived from the dataset-brainstorm-v3 seed bank with curated context_blocks for AM advisory workflows.
source: dataset-brainstorm-v3 seed bank — hard-eval coverage derived from DATASET_STRATEGY.md taxonomy

prompts.prompt: You are an Account Manager with only one weekly intervention slot. Decide whether SmartNest should get priority over other at-risk sellers, and justify using business impact, suspension risk, and salvageability. Output: ranked recommendation + rationale + 14-day plan.

context_blocks.seller_snapshot: Account health 72, ODR 3.08%, reserve hold 31%, Buy Box 33.4%.
context_blocks.asin_snapshot: Two top ASINs show 18%+ returns and suppression history.
context_blocks.event_log: Final warning and disbursement hold in last 30 days.
context_blocks.financial_snapshot: Margin compressed to near break-even after chargebacks.

prompts.prompt: Create a portfolio risk memo comparing CoastalCasa (ODR breach) and NorthPeak (suppression + returns risk). Recommend which seller gets AM escalation this week and why.

context_blocks.event_log: Both sellers had high-severity events in last 21 days.
context_blocks.financial_snapshot: Coastal has heavier reserve hold pressure than NorthPeak.
